name: a version that is not a number is malformed
front matter without fwmd is some other YAML and is ignored
text with no front matter takes the host's defaults
run text is normalised to NFD on import and attribute values are not
with normalisation off the text is as written
a link destination is written in NFC and compared under canonical equivalence
a record file is not read as FieldWorks Markdown: one finding on its record line, and nothing else (owner decision R-9)
